'''2016 European Championship Day 2 John Moorley LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Moorley]] at [[2016 European Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[John Moorley]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Username:''' DarthMoorley
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
